title: Global storage field
description: Best-practice rule — flags fields with global storage. Globals are shared per session and per user; overusing them makes state hard to reason about.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Global fields are convenient but hide shared mutable state across the whole session.
rule.remediation: Prefer variables / parameters for transient state; reserve globals for true constants.
